title: Assistant cards
subtitle: Rich UI in the main conversation, always on: the assistant shows options, comparisons, progress, forms and charts as cards; the conclusion stays in the text.
support_footer: What counts is the version installed on each client. Where a client lacks support it shows the card's text (fallback); nothing in the conversation is lost.
support_web_hint: Choosing, forms, live cards and HTML cards; HTML runs in an isolated runtime.
support_apple_hint: iPhone and iPad draw cards, take answers and run HTML cards; the Mac shows an HTML card's text.
support_android_hint: Choosing, forms and live cards with the shared components; HTML cards show their text until Android's security review passes.
preview_footer: Synthetic data from schema/extension/examples/assistant/, drawn with the same components as the web client. The preview is not connected to any conversation: presses and forms only change this page, nothing is sent.
example_missing: This example could not be found.
html_not_run: HTML cards do not run in the preview; only their text shows here.
html_hint: In a real conversation a client runs HTML only after passing its security review; otherwise it shows this text too.
press_hint: Press an option or a button on the card to see what it would do in a real conversation.
would_send: A real conversation would send back “{text}”
fallback_title: Text (watch, notifications and clients without support)
